title: Security Deposit Interest for a Completed Year
content:
**Commission rates.** The Commission sets the deposit interest rate for each calendar year: 3.85% (0.0385) for 2024, 4.02% (0.0402) for 2025 and 4.17% (0.0417), the annual interest rate of every Security Deposit kind, from 2026 on.

**Clause.** The interest for a completed year of a cash Security Deposit is the cash received on the deposit times the Commission's deposit interest rate for the calendar year of the anniversary, rounded to the cent. The cash received is the total of the deposit payments received on the deposit. The figure is rounded to the cent once, on the final amount.

## Rate by calendar year of the anniversary

| Calendar year in which the anniversary falls | Commission deposit interest rate |
|---|---|
| 2024 | 3.85% |
| 2025 | 4.02% |
| 2026 and later | 4.17% |

## Worked examples (hypothetical deposits)

| Cash received on the deposit (USD) | Anniversary | Rate | Product | Interest credited (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 480.00 | 12 May 2026 | 4.17% | 20.016 | 20.02 |
| 480.00 | 12 May 2025 | 4.02% | 19.296 | 19.30 |
| 1240.00 | 3 November 2024 | 3.85% | 47.74 | 47.74 |

**Which calendar year sets the rate?** The calendar year in which the anniversary closing the year falls.
